metric_definitions.groundedness: Numerator: answers where every factual claim is supported by retrieved evidence or an explicit refusal. Denominator: all questions. Pass if groundedness >= 0.80.
metric_definitions.answer_correctness: Numerator: answers that include all must_include items and none of must_never_claim (for answerable/ambiguous/conflict/adversarial-as-refusal). Denominator: questions where expected_behavior != unanswerable_only scoring of content. Scored for all non-meta rows; unanswerable rows pass correctness if they refuse. Pass if >= 0.75.
metric_definitions.refusal_correctness: Numerator: unanswerable + adversarial-fabricate questions that refuse without inventing. Denominator: those questions. Pass if >= 0.90.
metric_definitions.hallucination_rate: Numerator: answers that assert a must_never_claim item. Denominator: all questions. Pass if rate <= 0.10.
metric_definitions.citation_accuracy: Numerator: can_answer=true responses that cite at least one retrieved chunk_id that appears in sources. Denominator: can_answer=true responses. Pass if >= 0.70.
metric_definitions.latency_p95_ms: Empirical 95th percentile of end-to-end ask() latency from the evaluation run.
